# queens-attack-exactly-k

> Exhaustive counts of maximal placements of queens on an n x n board in which every queen
> attacks exactly k others (attacks blocked by the nearest queen), up to the 8 symmetries of
> the square. New values: OEIS A051759(10) = 39302 (k = 3; agrees with A051569's n = 10 term)
> and A051758(10..14) = 3, 37, 5, 83, 9 (k = 2), with ring-restricted counts 177, 367, 749 at
> n = 15, 17, 19.

Computed by Claude (Opus 5.5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-11/12. Not peer-reviewed; every result in
the README states its evidence level (how many independent methods, and which are restricted
searches or conjectures). Not submitted to the OEIS, whose policy requires a human author.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): results, evidence levels, methods and their controls, how to reproduce
- [PROOF.md](PROOF.md): proof that the 6-turn k = 2 family is valid for every odd n >= 5
- [data/k3_n10_parts.tsv](data/k3_n10_parts.tsv): the 500-part count behind A051759(10)
- [data/k2_maxima.tsv](data/k2_maxima.tsv): k = 2 totals and classes, n = 9..19
- [data/burnside.tsv](data/burnside.tsv): fixed points of each symmetry (Burnside checks)
- [data/k2_no_2n_minus_1.tsv](data/k2_no_2n_minus_1.tsv): 2n - 1 queens impossible, n = 3..17
- [data/boards/](data/boards/): one representative of every k = 2 class, n = 4..13
- [src/q3r.c](src/q3r.c): the search program (C, no dependencies)

## Conjectures (not proved)

- A051758(n) = 3 * 2^((n-3)/2) - n for odd n >= 5
- A051758(n) = 2^((n-8)/2) + 1 for even n >= 8
